name: Prioritize with the Pomodoro Technique
instructions: Use Pomodoro sessions inside a time block for extra structure -- a 90-minute block can become three 25-minute pomodoros with breaks.
Treat the timer as a commitment device: during a pomodoro, only the block's task exists.
Take the break between pomodoros seriously, even inside a longer block -- it is what keeps focus sustainable.
Watch today's short video explaining the technique.
